implementation: PlainTextRequest/Reply, AnnotationPolicy and explicit host ResolvedInlineText have executable Doc schema descriptors and native/portable APIs. BaseOnly, WithReadings and WithAllNotes retain nested content, author spaces and explicit breaks.

Document and guest identities use specified domain byte strings and canonical NDF. Every supplied resolution is checked against both identities and its embed, including duplicate entries; missing resolution fails only when the selected annotation policy actually visits that embed. No implicit guest evaluation occurs.

The operation revalidates its own request and source closure under the current budget. Source admission, identity generation and rendering share the budget; typed Invalid and Stopped replies preserve usage and stop causes without partial-success text.

Managed tests exercise original parsed input, three policies, source edits, guest/owner changes, first CBOR receivers, malformed resolutions, resource boundaries, source-less values and wide IDs. Independent expectations include direct SHA-256 calculations from domain bytes and canonical CBOR rather than copying operation-produced digests.

independent_review.scope: PlainText fixed15 only, independent actual standard four-language compilation, ParseSession, mixed lower and plain_text. Three original inputs by three policies, native/WASI freshly built. Source-less shape-only substitutes are not used. No Region WIP.
independent_review.managed: Five text integration tests independently rerun on native and WASI; root whole gate logs recorded separately.
independent_review.findings: No blocking finding in the frozen PlainText implementation and common operation mapping.

log_normalization: Root logs use LF and a final newline. Archived independent UTF-8 records preserve original bytes and SHA-256.
